about_the_game:
From the universe of Azur Lane to the Port you call home—pick up Commander Neptune along with a themed permanent camouflage! The personification of the UK light cruiser of the same name, she can take command of your British ships and comes with a unique Japanese-language voiceover.
This package includes:
  • British Commander Neptune with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover
  • 1x "Azur Lane — Siren" permanent camouflage
You can own an unlimited number of copies of Commander Neptune.
The "Azur Lane — Siren" permanent camouflage can be mounted on any ship. Once mounted, the camouflage is assigned to that ship. You can have an unlimited number of The Azur Lane — Siren permanent camouflages.
This time-limited exclusive DLC is only available until July 2, 2025.
